_help: Map tileset art. mem/tileset.mem is GENERATED from this file + the sheet PNG.  Rebuild: python scripts/build_tileset_mem.py
Game: 3 floors x 16 tile ids, 32x32 each. Sheet cells are 16x16 and are scaled exactly 2x (nearest neighbour, no smoothing).
cell = [row, col] of the sheet, both counted from 0.  base = tile id (same floor) drawn first, so see-through pixels show floor.

A tile may use its own picture: "file": path, "cell_size": 32 (cells of that size, scale = 32 / cell_size), "tint": [r,g,b] recolours grey art (grey 180 becomes the tint). my_asset/props/plate.png = 32x32 cells, row 0 raised plate, row 1 pressed plate. Sokoban plate = tile 7 (raised) / 11 (box on it); each Simon plate is a 2x2-tile block drawn as ONE big plate (renderer samples tiles 12-15 at half size).
Anything not listed, skipped, outside the sheet or fully transparent falls back to the old art in mem/tileset_v1.mem.

overrides._decor: tile ids 12-15 are decoration (crack, bones, skull, rubble) on floors 1 and 2; floor 3 keeps them as the Simon plates
overrides._example_1: "f2.t5": { "cell": [7, 8] }   floor 2, tile 5 uses another cell (f1..f3, t0..t15)
overrides._example_2: "f3.t0": { "skip": true }     floor 3, tile 0 uses the old art
